mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with quetiapine (atypical antipsychotic) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, orthostatic hypotension, and CNS depression through additive monoaminergic and sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid combination; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms, and ensure adequate washout period (14 days post-MAOI discontinuation) before initiating quetiapine.
